name: Arjun Moreau
headline: Software Engineer in Test
summary: Software engineer in test with a track record of building reliable automated checks and strengthening release confidence across product teams. Combines hands-on test automation, security-focused validation, and fast feedback loops to improve quality in complex delivery environments. Comfortable working across backend and user-facing work while partnering closely with engineers and product teams.

roles.title: Software Engineer in Test
bullets: Built C# test coverage for core application flows and reduced regression escapes by 28%.
Set up GitHub Actions workflows to run automated checks on every change and shorten feedback time for the team.
Expanded Selenium suites to cover critical browser journeys and improved repeatable verification before release.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
bullets: Led test automation planning in Agile delivery, using C#, Cypress and pytest to improve coverage across new features.
Built CI/CD checks on Azure and Docker, cutting release verification time by 35% for the team.
Validated REST APIs and React flows with JUnit, Python and test automation practices to catch issues earlier in the cycle.
Strengthened security review work with Cryptography, OAuth, penetration testing and SIEM findings to reduce exposure in sensitive paths.
Hardened Linux-based environments and ran controlled checks with Selenium-style browser coverage plus Cypress for end-to-end confidence.
